name: Machining
description: Are you interested in machining? Become a member and enjoy 24/7 access to our machine shop and community of makers who share your interest!

benefits.title: Manual Mill
benefits.description: Use our manual mill for precision cutting, drilling, and shaping of metal and other materials with fine control over your operations.

benefits.title: Lathe
benefits.description: Access our lathe for turning, threading, and shaping cylindrical workpieces with precision and control.

benefits.title: Drill Press
benefits.description: Use our drill press for accurate, repeatable drilling operations with consistent depth and alignment.

benefits.title: Bench Grinder Hand Tools
benefits.description: Access bench grinders and a complete set of hand tools for tool maintenance, sharpening, and precision machining work.

benefits.title: CNC Plastic
benefits.description: Use our CNC equipment to machine plastic with precision for prototyping and production runs.
benefits.footnote: Our machine can also cut Aluminum but requires additional tooling and special approval.
